sources.title: Minerals planning guidance
sources.role: Planning practice guidance for mineral safeguarding and extraction.
sources.facts: The guidance covers safeguarding, extraction impacts, restoration, aggregate supply and plan making.
sources.guard: Planning guidance and safeguarding do not establish an exact deposit, permission, permit or viable extraction scheme.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework: sustainable use of minerals
sources.role: National policy on mineral safeguarding and supply.
sources.facts: The framework addresses safeguarding areas, consultation areas, aggregate assessments and landbanks.
sources.guard: A safeguarding designation or landbank indicator does not create a presumption that resources will be worked.

sources.title: Category A mining waste facilities: financial provision
sources.role: Current Environment Agency guidance for financial provision at Category A mining-waste facilities.
sources.facts: Published 2 July 2026 and applies to specified mining-waste facilities in England.
sources.guard: Financial-provision guidance does not prove a facility category, accepted calculation, permit or operational compliance.

sources.title: Planning advice service for developing on the coalfield
sources.role: Mining Remediation Authority coalfield planning-advice service.
sources.facts: Updated 25 June 2026; the service supports consideration of historical coal-mining risks.
sources.guard: Pre-application advice is not a coal-mining risk assessment, planning decision or confirmation that land is stable.

sources.title: Coal Development High Risk Area
sources.role: Authoritative national dataset of coal development high-risk areas.
sources.facts: Updated 14 April 2026 and identifies areas containing recorded coal-mining features that may pose risks.
sources.origin: Mining Remediation Authority / National Data Library
sources.guard: A composite risk-area polygon does not prove a feature exists at an exact point or determine site safety or remediation.

sources.title: Mining, quarrying and extraction
sources.role: Official topic collection for mining permits, impacts and legacy hazards.
sources.facts: The collection links to licences, environmental permits, safety and mining-risk services.
sources.guard: A topic collection does not prove that any licence, permit, right or approval applies to a specific operation.

sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.facts: Updated 2 March 2026 and includes mining-waste operations among activities that may require permits.
sources.guard: Permit-screening guidance does not prove an exemption, permit grant, permit conditions or compliance.

sources.title: Get a permit to deal with coal or coal mines
sources.role: Mining Remediation Authority coal licence and agreement guidance.
sources.facts: The page includes April 2026 fees and application checklists for coal and mine activities.
sources.guard: Application guidance does not establish mineral ownership, a granted licence, incidental agreement or extraction feasibility.
